data_fixtures.description: Seeded admin analytics with operational KPIs, alerts, revenue, attendance, and modal-capable controls.

exclusions.reason: External AI generation is outside safe visual calibration; only the visible action and existing output states are judged.
The calibration opens and dismisses export configuration without committing a filesystem download.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Every declared Analytics state and viewport has fresh screenshot and structured runtime evidence.
No declared target overlaps, clips, escapes its container, or creates horizontal document overflow.
Date bounds and weekly, monthly, or yearly grouping remain independent with correct draft and applied control states.
PDF and drilldown dialogs are bounded, keyboard-contained, background-inert, dismissible, and return focus.
The contracted flow introduces no console error, unhandled rejection, failed critical request, or major layout shift.
The page communicates applied range, primary business signals, exploration sections, and secondary AI actions in a clear order.
The surface uses FitTrack color, typography, density, spacing, shape, and interaction rules with purposeful restraint.
